author: felipeblassioli@gmail.com
abstract: User-invoked promotion preflight gate for the agent-skills marketplace. Chains the deterministic skill-audit signals (audit-skill.sh), marketplace/registry alignment (marketplace-consistency.sh), and version + CHANGELOG presence into a go/no-go verdict that blocks promotion on any unresolved finding and cites the failing gate. Audit-first; read-only; harness-agnostic driver reusable in CI.
